entities.summary: Ismail Abu Hatab was a Palestinian photojournalist and filmmaker, creator of C-light and ByPa, a Palestinian creative collective. He was best known for his frontline coverage of the Gaza war. He organized several photography exhibitions outside the Gaza Strip. He was killed by an Israeli airstrike on 30 June 2025.
